decisions.reason: A schlager compilation CD sits in the warehouse-backed catalog at almost no carrying cost and fits the firm's core German-music collector base, so keeping the option open costs little.
The illustrated release series can be extended with new volumes once demand becomes clearer, and holding the existing titles in the catalog is cheap, so the series is worth keeping open.
Reissued jazz vinyl matches the growing vinyl collector market and the firm's reissue expertise, and keeping stock listed costs little, with no evidence that it has failed.
Multi-disc box sets are a signature curated product with long-tail collector demand, and once produced they cost little to keep on sale.
This compilation CD was only mentioned on the website and so may be less prominent, but the cost of listing it is negligible, so it stays until stock runs out or sales clearly fail.
